Mod.Name: Shared Storage
Mod.Author: NyanDoggo
Mod.Description: Every save gets a Shared Storage Bay (the storage bay with the cyan lid). Whatever is inside it is shared by all your saves and carries over into new runs: put something in, and it is waiting in the bay in every other save. It is one bay, not a copy machine: take an item out in one save and it is gone from the others. The contents sync each time the game saves.
